## Documentation and compatibility

- [ ] Relevant guides, examples, and changelog entries are updated, or no update is needed.
- [ ] Any required version change is synchronized with `library.json` and its mirrors, or no version change is needed.
- [ ] Examples, logs, and screenshots contain no credentials or private configuration.
